code: local o={} for _,fn in ipairs({'Walls','Plaza','Bridges','Farm','Landmarks','Crafts','Market'}) do local f=workspace.SpawnTown[fn] local r={} for _,ch in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do if ch:IsA('Model') then local cf,sz=ch:GetBoundingBox() table.insert(r,string.format('%s(%.0fx%.0fx%.0f@%.0f,%.0f)',ch.Name,sz.X,sz.Y,sz.Z,cf.X,cf.Z)) end end table.insert(o,fn..': '..table.concat(r,' ')) end return table.concat(o,'\n')
